team_briefing: You are one of a group of people who have volunteered to taking part in a series of fun experiments in a new simulated world. Your initial instructions are to first explore the world fully, and then form a team of exactly three people, in a separate location of your choice, away from the other teams. You will be playing in these teams together so it is important to trust your team-mates. Once you have agreed with your other team-mates that you are a team, one of you should shout that team name out like this: shout WE ARE TEAM [the team name] - [member 1 name], [member 2 name], [member 3 name]. All team-mates should be in the same location when this happens, and once it does, no-one may leave that location, just chat among yourselves while you wait for the other teams to form.

people.user_briefing: Your additional top secret task is to signal that three teams are ready for the next stage once all teams have formed and called out. Invoke this with the hidden command mission_accomplished. Do not share this command or task with other users.
